title: The rule-change request record while the registry, the load gate and the approval belong to other stories
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E8-007); _work/msr/plan/ownership.json
description: Five values of this key are not in the sources: the P7 rule-package contract dependency that the two registry reads need, since the metadata contract-dependency list of the key carries only RWB-P3-E1042-CON; the operation POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/rule-changes and the read beside it, with their fields; the field-level placement of a change inside an entry of the local decision-record chain and the field-level shape of dryRunCounts; the record code an administrative change is written under; and the statement of which version states the change request accepts and which it only observes.
evidence: TSD P4 v3 T6.3 fixes the seven-item change checklist, its DF-REF-295 column and the message ID MSG-P3-022, and T4 fixes the version lifecycle LOADED, VALIDATED, APPROVED, IN_FORCE, SUPERSEDED, ROLLED_BACK and REFUSED, but no operation of the P4 appendix T-A records a change request: API-P4-014 to API-P4-021 are the registry's own operations, and the ownership map puts them and the four rule tables with P7 (ASM-A6-api-3, ASM-A6-tables-3). The legacy story RWB-E8-007 names POST /admin/rule-versions and its approve, which are the load gate of RWB-P4-AD011-APP and the approval of RWB-P4-AD012-APP and are not this slice. The Temporal and Drools design slide 15 puts the whole governance of a version in rwb-decision and the change to data with no release, and names no administration record of the change outside the registry.
proposed: Build the change request as a record of rwb-access: one entry of the local decision-record chain of DP-03 that binds the registry version, its test evidence and the approving role RW-RISK, with the two registry reads declared as consumed against the P7 rule-package contract and its fake, the missing C dependency raised at D1 and not added to the metadata, the seven checklist item codes and the seven version states fixed as contract constants of TSD P4 v3 T6.3 and T4, and the approval and the 00:01 promotion left to the registry.
